scripts.build: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core packages/adapter-common packages/adapter-codex packages/adapter-copilot packages/receiver packages/hook-runner packages/hook-installer apps/desktop
scripts.clean: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core packages/adapter-common packages/adapter-codex packages/adapter-copilot packages/receiver packages/hook-runner packages/hook-installer apps/desktop --clean
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/protocol/dist/*.test.js packages/core/dist/*.test.js packages/adapter-codex/dist/*.test.js packages/adapter-copilot/dist/*.test.js packages/receiver/dist/*.test.js packages/hook-runner/dist/*.test.js packages/hook-installer/dist/*.test.js apps/desktop/dist/*.test.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/protocol packages/core packages/adapter-common packages/adapter-codex packages/adapter-copilot packages/receiver packages/hook-runner packages/hook-installer apps/desktop --pretty false
scripts.hooks:install: npm run build && node packages/hook-installer/dist/cli.js install
scripts.hooks:uninstall: npm run build && node packages/hook-installer/dist/cli.js uninstall
scripts.dist:windows: npm run build && npm run build:linux-payload && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --arm64
